§6Launch Pad§f is the single-block foundation every AR rocket needs to take off. It defines the origin of the rocket and stores the launch coordinates that the Rocket Assembling Machine reads.

Craft it shapeless: 1 Concrete Tile + 1 Black Dye + 1 Yellow Dye. The pad must be placed on a flat surface with a clear 3x3 column of air above for the rocket entity to spawn.

The pad has no GUI, right-clicking does nothing. Place a Rocket Assembling Machine adjacent and right-click the assembler to bind it to the pad.

§cWARNING:§f If the assembler complains 'Invalid Launchpad', the pad is not on the same Y level as the assembler or the air column is obstructed. Clear at least a 5x5 area around the pad.
